events.description: A red SUV turns right at an intersection and collides with a person on the sidewalk, who is thrown to the ground; an ambulance arrives shortly after.

verification.reason: In f4 (10.5s), the SUV begins turning right while a person is visible near the curb; in f5–f6 (11.0–11.5s), the person is no longer upright and appears on the ground near the SUV’s rear wheel; by f7 (12.0s), the SUV has stopped and the person remains on the ground, with an ambulance arriving at the scene—consistent with a vehicle-pedestrian collision.

events.description: A silver sedan enters the intersection from the left and collides with the front-left side of the dashcam vehicle, causing visible deformation and abrupt deceleration.

verification.reason: In f5 (26.5 s), the silver sedan’s rear is just entering the frame; in f6 (27.0 s), it is fully in view, angled sharply across the lane with its left rear corner contacting the dashcam vehicle’s front bumper—consistent with a low-speed side-impact collision. No rebound or skid marks suggest a minor but real crash. The event is bounded by f5–f6 as the contact occurs between those frames.

events.description: A blue tractor entering from the right at f2 veers sharply left and collides with the rear-right side of the black sedan at f5–f6, causing the tractor to tip onto its side and slide across the road.

verification.reason: Frames f5–f6 show the tractor in contact with the sedan and then overturned; dust/debris visible confirms impact; the event is continuous and matches both candidate intervals; no other explanation fits the sudden loss of control and rollover.
